purpose: Define the manifest structure for the first bounded historical replay package. This prepares real replay packaging but does not execute replay or expose outcomes.
scope_rule: Manifest contract only. No live feed pull, no runtime patch, no external API, no DB/schema/systemd change, no product-specific code.

manifest_files_to_create_later.name: selected_case_manifest
manifest_files_to_create_later.purpose: List selected historical cases and source refs without hidden outcome fields.

manifest_files_to_create_later.name: masked_input_manifest
manifest_files_to_create_later.purpose: Estimator-facing package containing only event-time-visible fields.

manifest_files_to_create_later.name: hidden_outcome_manifest
manifest_files_to_create_later.purpose: Separated outcome package locked until estimate seal exists.

manifest_files_to_create_later.name: leakage_check_report
manifest_files_to_create_later.purpose: Confirms visible inputs do not contain later outcome fields.

manifest_files_to_create_later.name: pre_replay_audit_report
manifest_files_to_create_later.purpose: Confirms package is ready for first bounded historical replay.

masked_input_manifest_schema.authority_rule: Masked input is estimator input only. It has no authority by itself.

hidden_outcome_manifest_schema.visibility_rule: Hidden outcome is not available until estimate hash/seal exists.

next_step_policy: After this manifest contract, run a pre-replay audit over local sources and produce bounded selected-case manifests only if enough suitable cases exist.
